description: Hiking trails from OpenStreetMap (via the free Waymarked Trails API), not from AllTrails, which blocks automated access: search by trail name or list routes around a point. Per trail: OSM ID, name, ref, network level, length in km, loop/linear, hardest OSM sac_scale difficulty, surfaces, operator, website, Wikidata, description and center point. No user ratings, reviews or photos (OSM has none). Coverage depends on OSM mapping. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: Number of trails with full details, 1 to 10 (default 5)

query.description: Trail name to search (or use lat/lon)

radiusKm.description: Search radius around lat/lon, 1 to 25 km (default 10)

name: social_alltrails
title: Social Alltrails
